controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: A triaxial ellipsoid based on the 10 × 8 × 7 km semi-axes in the IAU/WGCCRE PCK. Galileo resolved Adrastea only a few pixels across, so no craters, relief map or observed surface texture are represented. Neutral gray is a display material; shared lighting describes the model shape.
